Remark
[Failure without compactness] 1. ch12:2.3Compactness is necessary.
Proof

\sketch A surface of revolution generated by a curve asymptotic to its axis has nontrivial free homotopy classes containing curves of arbitrarily small length, so those classes have no length minimizer.

□
